svg.title: How LCW works, in two shapes. You say what you want and the main orchestrator picks the shape. A defined change is a Build: Brainstorm with you, then Spec. An open goal is a Sweep: a Charter you agree line by line, then a Hunt that fills a queue of waves. Both then run the same four stages, Plan, Build, Review and Ship: a Build once, a Sweep once for each wave, whose areas build in parallel. A wave joins the sweep's own branch, and one pull request carries that branch to main. After each wave the next one starts, or a new round of Hunt, until a round finds nothing to fix. Only the main orchestrator consults the Fable advisor. Every run keeps its records under ~/.lcw.
svg.text: Fable Advisor
a stronger model that sees the whole conversation
Only the main orchestrator consults it, wherever a box says “Fable advises”: before a big step, when stuck, and before calling anything done.
